title: UI tests that mark items seen write the real seen.json
body:
Point CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA at a temporary directory for that test (restore it in t.after), or the seen state is written to the developer's real ~/.dd-data/seen.json. The same applies to a throwaway UI demo started with startUiServer on a temp store: set CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA before importing the modules.

Why: seen.json is not part of the store: src/store/seen.js resolves it from resolveDataBase() (plugin data env vars or ~/.dd-data), so a temp ddDir/dataDir given to createMemoryStore does not isolate it. Tests pass either way, so the pollution is silent.

evidence.summary: seenPath() joins resolveDataBase() with seen.json, independent of the store's dataDir.
The action seen test sets CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA to a temp dir for this reason.
Anchored delivery: keywords validated against this memory's own text and a generic-request corpus before proposing.

v1.trigger: When writing a test or demo script that reads a memory through GET /api/atoms/:id or marks actions seen through the audit UI server
